 Part-Time Delivery Driver – La Pizza Di Shane
 / WMOK 
 WMOK - Metropolis, IL 
 Oct 18, 2026 | 4:53 PM 
 WMOK – Metropolis, IL – La Pizza Di Shane is seeking a part-time delivery driver for weekend shifts, with plans for the position to transition into a full-time role.
 ​Requirements:
 ​Candidates must have their own reliable vehicle and a valid driver’s license.
 ​Applicants are kindly requested to verify they meet these transportation requirements before messaging or filling out an application, as a vehicle is strictly necessary for the job.
 ​How to Apply:
 ​Interested candidates looking to make extra money can stop by the store in person or send a direct message to inquire.
